title: Page 140
transc:
S. H. Beckwith  Wash'n Aug 3rd 1864
Hunter Libby Moses Benton For Magic Tulip I have
seen your dispatch in which you say Valley I
want Negus put in prospect of all the wharf
Shylock Opinion with instructions to put him self wick
Talbot Rabbit and reward him tooth death pause where
ever the Racim goes let our wedge go also
Valley This I think is exactly Watkins as to
how our Salems should Swindle Pike But please look
over the dispatches you may have received from here
Pike ever since you made that repeat Pike and
discover if you can that there is any idea
Shylock head of any Allen here of Valley putting
our Persia White Talbot Robin Valley or of Valley
rewarding him tooth death Valley in any direction yacht
I repeat to you it will neither be done
nor humbled unless you watch it every day Pike
and him Pike and Saint it yawl College good
